checks.detail: universe does not declare point-in-time membership — any study over it is survivorship-biased and must be labelled so
no feature correlates with any label above 0.999

notes: observation stride 5 sessions, applied after feature computation so lookback windows remain in trading days
21 symbol(s) skipped for fewer than 260 sessions
cross-sectional columns (_xs) normalised within point-in-time universe membership only; names outside the universe on a date carry NULL there
macro features carry a one-session availability lag applied at source
8 option feature(s) attached as-of (latest snapshot at or before each date, 21-day staleness cap)
4 earnings feature(s) attached from the announcement's availability date, honouring before-open vs after-close; periods with no matching announcement are dropped

config.execution_lag_note: 0 = trade at the close the signal was computed from (not achievable); 1 = act one full rebalance period later (pessimistic bound).

costs.execution: Every trade executes at the rebalance date's close, at that close plus costs. There is no queue model, no partial fill and no intraday path — these are cost-adjusted closes, not simulated fills.
costs.spread_source: ASSUMED. The price dataset carries no bid/ask, so the half-spread is a parameter rather than an observation. It is the largest source of uncertainty in any net return reported here.

factor_attribution.verdict: Intercept is not distinguishable from zero (t = 0.32). The return series is explained by its factor exposures — largest loading rmw at -0.31. This is a return difference, not alpha.
factor_attribution.note: Dollar-neutral book: no risk-free deduction, since short proceeds fund the long leg.
factor_attribution.methodology: OLS of excess strategy returns on Fama-French 5 factors plus momentum. The intercept is alpha; its t-statistic is Newey-West corrected for autocorrelation induced by overlapping holding periods. Significance is |t| > 2.0.

deflated_sharpe.note: Compared against the best of 1029 zero-skill configuration(s), with the null threshold scaled by the trial dispersion Sharpe dispersion. Annualised figures shown; deflation computed per period.
deflated_sharpe.methodology: Deflated Sharpe Ratio (Bailey & Lopez de Prado, 2014). Adjusts for the number of configurations tried, for non-normal returns, and for sample length. Significance is a deflated probability above 0.95.

minimum_track_record.methodology: Minimum Track Record Length (Bailey & Lopez de Prado, 2012).

probability_of_backtest_overfitting.interpretation: The configuration chosen in-sample landed in the bottom half out-of-sample 93% of the time. Near 0.5 means in-sample selection carries no information about out-of-sample rank; below ~0.2 is where selection is doing real work.
probability_of_backtest_overfitting.excluded_reason: traded fewer than 60 periods; a degenerate configuration is not a competitor in the selection process PBO measures

multiple_testing.interpretation: A search of 873 configurations raises the cumulative count to 1029. The best of 1029 zero-skill configurations would be expected to show |t| ~ 3.38, so a finding must clear that before it is interesting, and ~4.06 to clear Bonferroni at 5%.

selected.ranked_by: net_sharpe at the declared 10 bp half-spread

gates.required: > 3.38, the expected max |t| of 1029 zero-skill configurations

verdict.note: Passing every gate makes this a DEVELOPMENT candidate only. The holdout is untouched and promotion remains blocked until it is spent under the contract.

holdout.note: Selection read validation folds only. Promotion to production remains blocked until the holdout is spent under the contract.
